name: CAD3D Studio — CAD Standardize
tagline: Any DWG → the ADS 10-layer standard → a clean 3D-ready model.
description: Inspects every layer of an incoming CAD file visually, maps it to the ADS ten-layer standard, and prepares a 3D-ready model — turning messy drawings into usable geometry automatically.

page.objective: Remove the manual grind of cleaning and standardizing incoming CAD before modeling.
page.problem: Every incoming DWG has different, non-standard layers that must be sorted by hand before any 3D work.
page.solution: Visual per-layer inspection + automatic mapping to the ADS standard, then a 3D-ready export.

highlights.headline: Converts CAD drawings to a QA'd 3D model in four export formats.
points: Standardizes every DWG/DXF layer to the ten ADS layers before modeling starts.
Exports to Revit (ADS Bridge), IFC4, glTF/Collada, and Rhino .3dm + JSON.
Every export writes an audit manifest.json; source files are never touched.
